traditional: A hard contact. Love, money, and pleasure works against limitation, delay, and hard structure - obstruction, friction, and strained outcomes in these areas. The benefic Venus tempers the malefic Saturn.
modern: Affection and value meet limit. Loyalty, restraint in pleasure and love, and a strong sense of obligation. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Difficulty enjoying success, fear of loss, blocked rewards, and free-floating guilt. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for connection against limit, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the connection/limit form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Loyal and hardworking; the risk is joyless striving and a belief that reward must be suffered for.
shadow: Indulgence and vanity collides with fear and rigidity; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.
base: Appreciation feels different when the praise continues but the practical condition that needs to change remains exactly the same.

readerCopy.body: Appreciation feels different when the praise continues but the practical condition that needs to change remains exactly the same. When Venus squares Saturn, affection, recognition, or value runs into a hard limit around money, time, availability, or commitment. Care can be sincere while the needed support is still unavailable. The situation becomes clearer once emotional value and practical capacity stop being treated as interchangeable.
